sections.title: Sun and Son
sections.line: Crowley on Tiphareth in the planetary system and in the system of Tetragrammaton: The Book of Thoth, pdf p177.

quotes.quote: In the planetary system it represents the Sun;
in the system of Tetragrammaton it represents the Son.

sections.title: Jung's Tifereth
sections.line: Jung on the usual arrangement of the Sefiroth, the middle position, and the sun: CW14 ¶18, ¶592 and ¶638.

quotes.quote: in the usual arrangement of the Sefiroth he occupies the second place
The figure of Tifereth belongs to the Sefiroth system, which is conceived to be a tree. Tifereth occupies the middle position
Yesod is as a part to the whole, and the whole is Tifereth, who is named the sun
